sentences.en: The Great Slate Podcast One Year tells stories of the people and struggles that changed America, one year at a time.
sentences.zh: 《一年》播客讲述了那些改变美国的人和事，一年一个故事。

sentences.en: In each episode, host Josh Levine explores a story that you may have forgotten or have a skewed memory of because you never knew the full context,
sentences.zh: 在每一集中，主持人乔什·莱文都会探索一个你可能已经遗忘，或者因为从未了解完整背景而记忆偏差的故事，

sentences.en: or maybe something you never even heard of before.
sentences.zh: 又或者是一些你从未听说过的事情。

sentences.en: They cover everything from the Challenger explosion to that time someone discovered an image of Jesus in a tortilla.
sentences.zh: 他们涵盖了从“挑战者号”航天飞机爆炸，到有人在玉米饼上发现耶稣影像的各种事件。

sentences.en: It's really smart and well-made, and one of those shows that I'll hear an episode of and I'll think,

sentences.en: They've done four seasons, each covering a different year.
sentences.zh: 他们已经制作了四季，每一季涵盖不同的一年。

sentences.en: The 1942 season is the most recent and had a lot of stories that resonated with what's going on in the world today.
sentences.zh: 1942年那一季是最近的，其中有很多故事与当今世界发生的事情产生了共鸣。

sentences.en: It's an episode from that set that I want to share.

sentences.en: It's called The Day the Music Stopped.
